title: How to care for quails
summary: Basic tips to raise healthy quails
content: Keep quails in a clean cage, provide balanced feed, fresh water, and monitor their health regularly.

title: Best feeding plan for laying quails
summary: Learn how to improve egg production with a proper feeding plan
content: Use high-protein feed, clean water, calcium supplements, and maintain a regular feeding schedule.

title: Incubation steps for quail eggs
content: Start with clean fertile eggs, maintain correct temperature and humidity, check regularly, then move eggs before hatch day if needed.
